text:
Anika: Hey all — starting today! Quick onboarding Qs: where do I put a hardware request (monitor/keyboard)? Who do I ping for badge/KMS access? And how do people typically silence noisy CI/deploy bots without missing critical alerts? Thanks!

Jared: Welcome Anika :tada: Hardware requests go to #people-ops (fill the hardware form) — tag your manager. Badge/KMS -> @Priya or #eng-security. For infra perms, see #eng-infra and open a ticket there.

Samira: Re: noisy bots — two options we use: 1) change channel notification prefs (Channel name > Settings > Notifications > Only mentions) or 2) if it's one bot spamming, ask DevEx to adjust its webhook level. We try not to mute everything so we don't miss alarms.

Onboarding Bot: Suggested next steps for Anika: 1) Fill hardware form -> https://notion.redwood/workspace/hardware-request 2) Complete access checklist -> /onboard checklist 3) Join #new-hires and #people-ops.

DevEx: If you want me to reduce chatter from the deploy bot in specific channels, ping me and I can scope its notifications by environment. Example command I use for the deploy app: `/deploybot set-level channel:staging level:info` (only app admins can run it).

Priya: Hi Anika — I'm Priya from People Ops. Submit the form linked above and we'll aim to ship peripherals within 3 business days. For badge access DM me your badge name and manager. If you need a laptop image, mention it on the form.

Max: For repo/KMS access, open an infra ticket in #eng-infra and include the repo names + reason. If you need CI write perms, add `ci-team` to the ticket.

Anika: Awesome, thanks! One small etiquette Q: lunch invites — post in #lunch-plans or just DM people? Also, is it OK to post non-urgent questions in #eng or should I thread them?

Jared: Lunch in #lunch-plans is perfect :sandwich:. For engineering questions, post in the specific team channel (e.g., #eng-runtime) and use threads for back-and-forth. DMs are fine for 1:1s or async quick checks.

Samira: Little tip — if you want to mute a single bot, click the bot message > More actions > Mute @bot-name. That only mutes direct bot mentions from that app, not the whole channel.

Infra Bot: Security reminder: do not post secret tokens in Slack. Use secure vaults and link tickets with the vault reference.

Anika: Got it — thanks everyone, super helpful. I'll file the forms and ping @Priya and @Max if anything needs follow-up. :nerd_face:

Priya: Welcome again — ping me anytime.

DevEx: If you want, I can do a 10-min Slack prefs walkthrough later today.

Anika: That would be great — thanks!
